signals.summary: GitLab begins a restructuring with a voluntary separation window, planning to finalize the new company shape by June 1.
Final restructuring scope disclosed: roughly 14% of global workforce, about 350 team members, with R&D taking the largest severance share.
GitLab posted over $1 billion in annual recurring revenue, so the restructuring is not driven by financial distress.
First-quarter revenue of $264.2 million, up 23% year over year from $214.5 million.
R&D reorganized into roughly 60 smaller, empowered teams with end-to-end ownership, nearly doubling independent teams.
R&D expense still rose 33% year over year while engineering headcount was reduced and senior AI engineering hiring remained challenging.
